# Canvas Sermon Archive

> Searchable transcripts of 238 sermons from Canvas Community Church in Winchester, Virginia, covering 2021-09-06 to 2026-08-10 (194 hours of audio, 1,725,802 words).

## What this is, and what it is not

- This is an **unofficial archive**, built and hosted by a member of the congregation. It is not published, reviewed, or endorsed by Canvas Community Church.
- The **authoritative source** is the church's own YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@CanvasWinchester. Every sermon here links back to the exact timestamp on that channel, and the video is what should be trusted where the two disagree.
- The sermons are **public**: they were livestreamed and remain publicly available on that channel. Nothing here is private or leaked material.
- Spoken content belongs to Canvas Community Church and its speakers. The transcription tooling is the archive author's work.

## How the transcripts were produced

- Audio was transcribed locally with OpenAI's Whisper model (`whisper.cpp`, `large-v3-turbo`). No human has edited or verified them.
- Expect machine transcription errors, especially in proper nouns, place names, and scripture references. Speaker names are often absent.
- Summaries, key points, themes, and scripture lists were generated by a language model from those transcripts, so they inherit those errors and add their own. They are a finding aid, not a citation.
- **If you are quoting this material, verify it against the linked video first.** Cite the sermon and channel, not this site.

## Plain text

Every sermon is available as unstyled UTF-8 text at `https://average-gary.github.io/canvas-church-transcripts/text/<slug>.txt`, and as timed subtitles at `https://average-gary.github.io/canvas-church-transcripts/srt/<slug>.srt`. The text files carry the title, date, and source URL as a three-line header, then prose. Prefer these over the HTML.

## Browse

- [All sermons, newest first](https://average-gary.github.io/canvas-church-transcripts/all/): the full list in one page
- [Timeline](https://average-gary.github.io/canvas-church-transcripts/timeline/): by year and series
- [Series](https://average-gary.github.io/canvas-church-transcripts/series/): 42 preaching series
- [Themes](https://average-gary.github.io/canvas-church-transcripts/themes/): 493 topical tags
- [Scripture](https://average-gary.github.io/canvas-church-transcripts/scripture/): 60 books of the Bible cited
- [Search](https://average-gary.github.io/canvas-church-transcripts/search/): full-text search (needs JavaScript; fetch the text files directly instead)
